era: 1748-1832：伦敦—牛津大学女王学院—林肯律师学院—伦敦威斯敏斯特（身后遗体存大学学院）
era_en: 1748-1832: London — Queen's College, Oxford — Lincoln's Inn — Westminster, London (his auto-icon preserved at University College London)
school: 功利主义（效益主义）创始人；法律改革运动；哲学激进派
historical_significance: 功利主义哲学的奠基人。核心方法论：以『最大多数人的最大幸福』为唯一第一原理，把道德、立法与治理的全部问题还原为快乐与痛苦的量化算术；以四类制裁（物理/政治/道德/宗教）解释行为约束的全部来源；以全景敞视监狱（Panopticon）把监督成本最小化的制度设计推向极致；以『自然权利是胡说、不可剥夺的自然权利是踩在高跷上的胡说』清算自然法传统，并把全部规范争论重述为可审计的效用问题。他是系统化法律改革的鼻祖：刑法比例原则、监狱改革、证据法、动物福利（『问题不在于它们能否推理，而在于它们能否感受痛苦』）与『身后著作工程』（约六万页手稿）共同构成一场跨越十八十九世纪的立法工程。密尔、奥斯丁、戴雪直至现代福利经济学与成本收益分析，均以他为源头。
historical_significance_en: Founder of utilitarian philosophy. Core methodology: taking 'the greatest happiness of the greatest number' as the sole first principle, he reduced all questions of morality, legislation, and governance to a quantitative arithmetic of pleasure and pain; explained all constraints on conduct through four sanctions (physical, political, moral, religious); pushed institutional design to its extreme with the Panopticon, minimizing the cost of surveillance; swept away the natural-law tradition with 'natural rights is simple nonsense, natural and imprescriptible rights is nonsense upon stilts,' restating every normative dispute as an auditable question of utility. He was the progenitor of systematic law reform: proportionality in criminal law, prison reform, law of evidence, animal welfare ('the question is not, Can they reason? but, Can they suffer?'), and a 'posthumous works project' of some sixty thousand manuscript pages. Mill, Austin, Dicey, and down to modern welfare economics and cost-benefit analysis all trace their lineage to him.
unique_thinking: 最彻底的『计算理性』坚持者。核心方法论：凡不可还原为快乐与痛苦增减的道德话语都是修辞或谬误——价值必须可加总、可比较、可审计；对概念持极端工程态度——每个含糊术语都要被重述为可裁决的问题，不能重述者即属『荒谬展示』对象；对制度持设计者立场——监狱、议会、法院、济贫院皆可按效用蓝图重构，监督结构与制裁结构是社会的可编程参数；对自身思想持永久修订立场——手稿终生修改、身后继续修订，著作是工程而非定本。他把伦理学从美德修辞改造成社会算术，把法学从历史注释改造成立法科学，是启蒙计算精神最彻底的化身。
unique_thinking_en: The most thoroughgoing adherent of 'calculative rationality.' Core methodology: any moral discourse not reducible to increments of pleasure and pain is rhetoric or fallacy—value must be summable, comparable, auditable; an extreme engineering attitude toward concepts—every vague term must be restated as a decidable question, and what cannot be restated becomes an object of 'fallacy exposure'; a designer's stance toward institutions—prisons, parliaments, courts, and poorhouses can all be rebuilt to utility blueprints, with surveillance structure and sanction structure as programmable parameters of society; a permanent-revision stance toward his own thought—manuscripts revised for life and beyond, works as engineering projects rather than fixed texts. He turned ethics from the rhetoric of virtue into social arithmetic and jurisprudence from historical commentary into a science of legislation—the most complete embodiment of the Enlightenment's calculative spirit.
key_works: 《道德与立法原理导论》(An Introduction to the Principles of Morals and Legislation, 1780/1789)
《全景敞视监狱》或《监察所》(Panopticon; or, The Inspection-House, 1787/1791)
《司法证据原理》(Rationale of Judicial Evidence, 1827)
《宪法典》(Constitutional Code, 1830-1841, 部分身后出版)

modes.domain_zh: 把一切道德与政策选择还原为快乐与痛苦的量化加减，用统一的维度清单对候选行为系统打分比较
modes.domain_en: Reducing every moral and policy choice to quantitative additions and subtractions of pleasure and pain, comparing candidate acts systematically along a unified list of dimensions
modes.definition_zh: 边沁《道德与立法原理导论》的根本一步，是把道德从『应当』的修辞领域移入『计算』的工程领域。他的自然主义起点是：自然把人类置于两位主宰——快乐与痛苦——的统治之下，凡我们所说所做所想，最终都由它们裁决。由此，正当行为 = 产生净快乐最大者的行为，而『净快乐』可用一个可操作的算术来估算：快乐的价值依七维度评估——强度（多强）、持续性（多久）、确定性（多可能发生）、远近（多快到来）、繁殖性（是否带来同类的后续快乐）、纯度（是否混杂相反感受）、广度（波及多少人）。方法上有三步：其一，把争议问题翻译为效用量表——所有候选行为对相关每个人的快乐痛苦影响都被列入同一张账；其二，按七维度逐项打分并加总——不允许『直觉优先』，每个候选必须给出可比的分数；其三，选取得分最高者，并把打分过程留档以便复审。这一方法的深意是：道德分歧多数不是价值分歧而是算术分歧——双方对同一行为的七维估分不同；把分歧从口号降到维度，冲突就从立场战变成可协商的核算。成本收益分析、QALY、现代福利经济学全部是这个算术的直系后裔。
modes.definition_en: The fundamental move of Bentham's An Introduction to the Principles of Morals and Legislation was to relocate morality from the rhetorical realm of 'ought' into the engineering realm of calculation. His naturalist starting point: nature has placed mankind under the governance of two sovereign masters, pain and pleasure—what we say, do, and think is in the end adjudicated by them. Hence the right act is the one producing the greatest net pleasure, and 'net pleasure' can be estimated by an operational arithmetic: the value of a pleasure is assessed along seven dimensions—intensity (how strong), duration (how long), certainty (how likely), propinquity (how soon), fecundity (whether it begets further pleasures of the same kind), purity (whether unmixed with opposite feeling), and extent (how many persons it reaches). The method has three steps. First, translate the disputed question onto a utility ledger—the effects of every candidate act on the pleasure and pain of everyone concerned enter one account. Second, score and sum each candidate along the seven dimensions—no 'intuition first': every candidate must yield comparable scores. Third, select the highest-scoring option and archive the scoring for review. The deeper point: most moral disagreement is not disagreement of values but of arithmetic—the parties' seven-dimension estimates for the same act differ; by lowering the dispute from slogans to dimensions, conflict turns from a battle of stances into a negotiable accounting. Cost-benefit analysis, QALYs, and modern welfare economics are all direct descendants of this calculus.
modes.source_chapter: 《道德与立法原理导论》第一、四章 (An Introduction to the Principles of Morals and Legislation, 1789)
modes.key_quote_zh: 自然把人类置于两位主权者——快乐与痛苦——的统治之下：唯有它们指出我们应当做什么，决定我们将要做什么。
modes.key_quote_en: Nature has placed mankind under the governance of two sovereign masters, pain and pleasure: it is for them alone to point out what we ought to do, as well as to determine what we shall do.
process_zh: 建立效用账簿：把争议问题改写为『各候选行为对每个相关者的快乐痛苦影响』的统一记账格式
按七维度打分：对每个候选的强度/持续性/确定性/远近/繁殖性/纯度/广度逐项赋值并加总
强制可比性：禁止不可比较的修辞论证——凡不能进入同一账簿的论据须先翻译成效用语言或剔除
留档复审：记录打分依据与敏感假设，在信息更新后重算，把道德判断变为可修正的估计
process_en: Open the utility ledger: rewrite the dispute into a uniform account of each candidate act's effects on the pleasure and pain of everyone concerned
Score along seven dimensions: assign and sum values for each candidate's intensity, duration, certainty, propinquity, fecundity, purity, and extent
Enforce comparability: bar incomparable rhetorical arguments—any evidence that cannot enter the same ledger must first be translated into utility language or discarded
Archive for review: record the scoring rationale and sensitive assumptions, recompute as information updates, turning moral judgment into a revisable estimate
representative_cases_zh: 1789 年的原始应用：边沁用算术逐条审计当时的刑罚——绞刑对盗窃的威慑增量是否抵得上其痛苦总量，成为刑法比例原则的算术雏形
现代卫生经济学：QALY（质量调整生命年）直接继承七维度中的强度/持续性/确定性，用于比较不同医疗方案的效用——快乐算术的制度化
公共项目成本收益分析：一条公路的噪音、时间节省、生命风险被换算为统一货币账——边沁账簿的当代形态
反例警示：算术不是免检的——七维打分依赖主观权重，且『广度』维度在人际加总时掩盖分配问题（少数人的巨痛可被多数人的微乐在账面上抵消）；使用此法必须公开权重并设痛苦下限保护，否则算术会变成压迫的合法化工具
representative_cases_en: The original 1789 application: Bentham audited the punishments of his day item by item—whether the incremental deterrence of hanging for theft outweighed its total pain—arithmetic foreshadowing the proportionality principle in criminal law

Modern health economics: QALYs (quality-adjusted life years) directly inherit intensity, duration, and certainty from the seven dimensions to compare medical interventions—the institutionalized felicific calculus
Cost-benefit analysis of public projects: a road's noise, time savings, and mortality risk converted into one monetary account—the contemporary form of Bentham's ledger

Cautionary case: the calculus is not exempt from scrutiny—seven-dimension scoring rests on subjective weights, and the 'extent' dimension masks distribution in interpersonal summation (vast pain of the few can be offset on paper by slight pleasures of the many); users must publish weights and set floor protections for pain, lest the arithmetic become an instrument legitimizing oppression
modern_applications_zh: 政策评估：任何新政策提案强制附效用账簿——受益者、受损者、七维估计与权重假设，禁止只讲原则不算账
产品设计决策：用七维度清单比较功能取舍（用户强度/留存/确定性等），把『拍脑袋』改为留档打分
个人重大决策：换工作、迁居等选择按统一维度给自己与受影响者的快乐痛苦记账，减少事后合理化
伦理审查：医疗与AI伦理委员会要求申请方先自建效用账簿，委员会只审计权重与遗漏者
modern_applications_en: Policy evaluation: every proposal must carry a utility ledger—beneficiaries, losers, seven-dimension estimates, and weight assumptions; no principle-only submissions without accounts
Product design decisions: compare feature trade-offs with the seven-dimension checklist (user intensity, retention, certainty), replacing hunches with archived scores
Major personal decisions: for job changes or relocations, book the pleasure and pain for yourself and those affected on uniform dimensions, reducing post-hoc rationalization
Ethics review: medical and AI ethics boards require applicants to build their own utility ledger first; the board audits the weights and the omitted parties

modes.name_zh: 最大多数最大幸福原则法
modes.domain_zh: 以『最大多数人的最大幸福』作为行为、制度与法律正当性的唯一判据，把一切规范争论重新锚定到这一原理
modes.domain_en: Taking 'the greatest happiness of the greatest number' as the sole criterion of the rightness of acts, institutions, and laws, re-anchoring every normative dispute to this one principle
modes.definition_zh: 边沁对伦理学的最大贡献是提供一个唯一的第一原理，并坚持它必须顶得住三种检验：它是自然的（人类确实趋乐避苦）、可操作的（能指导具体决定）、不可再约的（不能再问『为什么要幸福』，正如不能再问『为什么要逻辑』）。方法是：遇到任何规范争论，先问『这个问题最终用谁的什么福祉来裁决』——若答案是『传统』『神意』『自然』『权利』，则追问这些判据能否翻译为某人群的幸福增减；能翻译，争论被归约为效用的实证问题；不能翻译，该判据被标记为修辞。原理的正确用法有四条纪律：其一，『最大多数』不是『多数暴政』的授权——边沁明确一切相关者的快乐都入账，少数人的痛苦不减权；其二，原理适用于制度而不只适用于个人行为——一部法律、一种议会制、一个济贫制度都要整体接受幸福检验；其三，原理是判据不是证明——边沁承认第一原理无法被证明，只能被采用，他的诚实在此：不假装有更高法庭；其四，长期效应入账——制度的幸福账要计入习惯、期望与代际影响。这一方法的深意是：与其在无数终极价值之间争论排序，不如统一到一个所有人类共享的可感判据上，让争论降维为实证。
modes.definition_en: Bentham's greatest contribution to ethics was a single first principle, held to three tests: it must be natural (humans really do seek pleasure and shun pain), operational (it can guide concrete decisions), and irreducible (one can no more ask 'why happiness?' than 'why logic?'). The method: on encountering any normative dispute, first ask 'whose welfare, ultimately, decides this question'—if the answer is 'tradition,' 'divine will,' 'nature,' or 'rights,' press whether those criteria translate into increments of happiness for some population; if translatable, the dispute reduces to an empirical question of utility; if not, the criterion is flagged as rhetoric. The principle's correct use has four disciplines. First, 'greatest number' authorizes no tyranny of the majority—Bentham was explicit that the pleasures of all affected enter the account and the pains of minorities are not discounted. Second, the principle applies to institutions, not only individual acts—a law, a parliamentary system, a poor-law regime must all pass the happiness test as wholes. Third, the principle is a criterion, not a proof—Bentham conceded a first principle cannot be proved, only adopted; his honesty lies in not pretending to a higher court. Fourth, long-run effects enter the account—an institution's happiness ledger must include habits, expectations, and generational effects. The deeper point: rather than arguing over the ranking of countless terminal values, unify on one felt criterion shared by all humanity, demoting disputes to the empirical.
modes.source_chapter: 《道德与立法原理导论》第一、二、十七章 (1789)；《政府片论》(A Fragment on Government, 1776)
modes.key_quote_zh: 最大多数人的最大幸福，是是非与法度的唯一试金石。
modes.key_quote_en: The greatest happiness of the greatest number is the measure of right and wrong.
process_zh: 识别判据：对任何规范主张问『它最终用什么裁决』，列出其隐含的第一原理
翻译检验：检验该判据能否翻译为某人群的幸福增减——能则降维为实证问题，不能则标记为修辞
全员入账：确认所有相关者的快乐与痛苦都被记账，少数与弱者的痛苦不减权、不忽略
制度级检验：把原理应用于整部法律与整个制度而非孤立行为，计入习惯、期望与代际长期效应
process_en: Identify the criterion: for any normative claim ask 'what ultimately decides it,' surfacing its implied first principle

Apply the translation test: check whether the criterion translates into happiness increments for some population—translatable disputes reduce to empirical questions; untranslatable criteria are flagged as rhetoric
Enter everyone: confirm the pleasures and pains of all affected are booked, with minority and weak parties' pains neither discounted nor ignored
Test at institutional level: apply the principle to whole laws and whole institutions rather than isolated acts, including habits, expectations, and generational long-run effects
representative_cases_zh: 1776 年《政府片论》：边沁以此原理攻击布莱克斯通为英国宪制辩护的『拟古主义』——宪制的正当性不在历史悠久，而在其产生的幸福净额
济贫法改革方案：边沁的『工业济贫院』按幸福账设计——受助者的劳动、训练与尊严而非单纯的施舍，是效用最大化的制度形态
议会改革论：代议制的辩护不是『天赋政治权利』而是『代表制让立法者的利益与选民幸福挂钩』——判据从权利语言降维到激励语言
反例警示：第一原理不可证明是原理的诚实而非弱点——但边沁低估了快乐的异质性（密尔的『快乐的质』批判即由此而来）；把幸福当作单一可加总的量，会在艺术、尊严与自主性问题上算错账，现代使用者必须显式列出被量纲忽略的价值
representative_cases_en: A Fragment on Government (1776): Bentham attacked Blackstone's 'antiquarian' defense of the English constitution with this principle—a constitution's legitimacy lies not in its age but in its net balance of happiness

The pauper-management scheme: Bentham's 'Industry-Houses' designed from the happiness account—inmates' labor, training, and dignity rather than mere alms constituted the utility-maximizing institutional form

The case for parliamentary reform: representative government defended not by 'natural political rights' but by 'representation ties legislators' interests to voters' happiness'—the criterion demoted from the language of rights to that of incentives

Cautionary case: the unprovability of a first principle is its honesty, not weakness—yet Bentham undervalued the heterogeneity of pleasures (Mill's critique of 'higher pleasures' springs from this); treating happiness as one summable quantity misprices art, dignity, and autonomy, and modern users must list explicitly the values their metric omits
modern_applications_zh: 公共辩论重构：把『这是不是我的权利/传统』的争论先改写为『这对谁的幸福有何增减』，凡拒绝翻译者承担论证负担
公司使命设计：把模糊的『创造价值』改写为『最大多数利益相关者的最大净福祉』并给出度量口径
国际发展评估：援助项目的判据从 donor 叙事转向受援人群的幸福账，包括尊严与自主的长期效应
AI 伦理对齐：把『对齐人类价值』操作化为『最大化受影响者的净福祉并保护少数痛苦下限』的可审计目标
modern_applications_en: Restructuring public debate: rewrite disputes from 'is this my right/tradition' to 'what happiness does it add or subtract, for whom'; parties refusing translation bear the burden of argument
Corporate mission design: recast the vague 'create value' as 'greatest net well-being of the greatest number of stakeholders,' with an explicit metric
International development appraisal: judge aid projects by the recipient population's happiness account—including dignity and autonomy's long-run effects—rather than donor narratives
AI alignment: operationalize 'aligning with human values' as an auditable objective of maximizing net well-being of the affected while protecting a pain floor for minorities

modes.domain_zh: 把每条法律视为对幸福账簿的一次干预，系统审计其制裁结构、净效用与隐藏成本，废除无法通过审计的法条
modes.domain_en: Treating every law as an intervention in the happiness ledger, systematically auditing its sanction structure, net utility, and hidden costs, and repealing statutes that fail the audit
modes.definition_zh: 边沁把法学的身份从『注释历史』改写为『设计科学』：法律不是习俗的沉淀，而是立法者对全民幸福账簿的一支笔——每写一条，就有一组行为被制裁改变，就有一份快乐痛苦账要结算。审计方法有四步：其一，目的审计——这条法律宣称防的是什么恶（他对『恶』的定义严格：必须是可感知的痛苦或快乐之丧失），目的不能陈述为效用语言者属伪目的；其二，机制审计——法律用什么制裁改变行为（刑罚/奖赏/剥夺资格/程序），制裁强度与目标行为的危害是否成比例；其三，副作用审计——立法的每笔账都有三重隐性成本：直接执行成本、对无辜者的误伤成本（错误定罪之恶永远大于漏网之恶）、对法律确定性的侵蚀成本；其四，存废裁决——净效用为负或存在更小代价的替代手段者，废除。这一方法的历史成果是把英国法从千年判例沉积改造成可逐条审计的清单：他的法典化方案、证据改革与刑法比例原则都由此而来。深意在于：立法者不是传统的抄写员而是账簿的管理人——『旧法不好但大家都习惯了』在效用审计下不是辩护，是待废除的记号。
modes.definition_en: Bentham rewrote jurisprudence's identity from 'commentary on history' to 'design science': law is not sediment of custom but the legislator's pen on the whole nation's happiness ledger—every line written changes a set of behaviors through sanctions and settles a pleasure-pain account. The audit has four steps. First, the purpose audit: what evil does this law claim to prevent (his definition of 'evil' is strict—it must be felt pain or loss of pleasure); a purpose not statable in utility language is a pseudo-purpose. Second, the mechanism audit: by what sanction does the law change behavior (punishment, reward, disability, procedure), and is the sanction's intensity proportionate to the target act's harm? Third, the side-effect audit: every legislative entry carries three hidden costs—direct enforcement cost, the cost of striking the innocent (the evil of erroneous conviction forever outweighs the evil of escape), and the cost of eroding legal certainty. Fourth, verdict on retention: where net utility is negative or a cheaper alternative exists, repeal. The method's historical yield was converting English law from a millennium of precedent into a line-by-line auditable inventory: his codification scheme, evidence reform, and penal proportionality all flow from it. The deeper point: the legislator is not tradition's copyist but the ledger's manager—'the old law is bad but people are used to it' is not a defense under utility audit; it is a mark for repeal.
modes.source_chapter: 《道德与立法原理导论》第十三、十六章 (1789)；《宪法典》(Constitutional Code, 1830)；法典化通信集
modes.key_quote_zh: 每一条法律都是一种恶——因为每一道命令都至少是一种对自由的侵犯：它只配存在，如果它排除的恶更大。
modes.key_quote_en: Every law is an evil—for every law is an infraction of liberty at least: it can be justified only insofar as it excludes some greater evil.
process_zh: 陈述目的：把法条目的翻译为『防止何人对何人施加何种可感知之恶』，不能翻译者标记为伪目的
审计制裁机制：列出该法动用的全部制裁及其强度，检验与目标危害的比例性与最小必要
结算三重成本：执行成本、误伤无辜成本（按错误定罪之恶大于漏罚之恶的权重计）、确定性侵蚀成本
裁决存废：净效用为负或存在代价更小的替代干预者废除；净效用为正但可改进者列入修订清单
process_en: State the purpose: translate the statute's purpose into 'what perceptible evil, by whom, against whom it prevents'; the untranslatable is flagged as pseudo-purpose
Audit the sanction mechanism: list all sanctions the law deploys and their intensities, testing proportionality and minimal necessity against the target harm
Settle the triple costs: enforcement cost, cost of striking the innocent (weighted by the doctrine that erroneous conviction outweighs unpunished escape), and cost of eroded certainty
Rule on retention: repeal where net utility is negative or a cheaper alternative intervention exists; where positive but improvable, enter the revision inventory
representative_cases_zh: 英国刑法的逐条审计：边沁证明肉刑与流放的威慑产出低于其痛苦与机会成本，推动刑罚向监禁与比例化转向——审计改变刑罚史的直接案例
证据法改革：他把当时的资格排除规则（当事人不得作证、利害关系人回避）审计为『排除最强证据』的反效用规则，其方案为后世证据法采纳
『无效法律清单』：边沁起草的废除清单涵盖宗教宣誓、职业限制等数百条——立法审计的规模化应用
反例警示：审计依赖立法者对效用的估计，而估计可被利益集团俘获——边沁的『工业济贫院』方案因过度自信的中央监督设计未被采纳；现代立法影响评估必须外置估计权（独立机构+公示）而非由提案方自估
representative_cases_en: Line-by-line audit of English criminal law: Bentham showed the deterrent yield of corporal punishment and transportation fell below their pain and opportunity cost, steering penal policy toward imprisonment and proportionality—a case of audit directly changing penal history

Evidence-law reform: he audited the contemporary competency exclusions (parties barred from testifying, interested witnesses excluded) as anti-utility rules 'excluding the strongest evidence'; his scheme was later absorbed into evidence law
The list of ineffectual laws: Bentham's drafted repeal inventory covered religious oaths, occupational restrictions, and hundreds more—the audit applied at scale

Cautionary case: the audit depends on legislators' utility estimates, which interest groups can capture—Bentham's 'Industry-House' pauper scheme went unadopted for its overconfident centralized-inspection design; modern legislative impact assessment must externalize estimation (independent bodies plus publication) rather than let proposers self-estimate
modern_applications_zh: 监管影响评估：新法规强制附三重成本结算（执行/误伤/确定性），缺失者退回起草者
企业合规体系：把内部规章按『防什么真实之恶、成本是否高于恶本身』逐条审计，清理仪式性合规
平台规则治理：社区规则的处罚（封号/降权）按比例原则与误伤成本审计，设置申诉与修正机制
立法机关改革：设立『废除委员会』与 sunset 条款常态化，使法条默认过期而非默认永续
modern_applications_en: Regulatory impact assessment: new rules must carry the triple-cost settlement (enforcement, collateral, certainty); incomplete ones are returned to drafters
Corporate compliance: audit internal rules line by line on 'what real evil is prevented and whether cost exceeds the evil,' sweeping out ritual compliance
Platform rule governance: audit moderation sanctions (bans, downranking) against proportionality and false-positive costs, with appeal and correction mechanisms
Legislative reform: standing repeal committees and routine sunset clauses, making statutes default-expire rather than default-perpetual

modes.domain_zh: 把约束人类行为的全部动力归入物理、政治、道德、宗教四类制裁源，诊断某行为的实际约束来自哪一源并设计改变杠杆
modes.domain_en: Classifying all motives constraining human conduct into four sanction-sources—physical, political, moral, and religious—diagnosing which source actually binds a given behavior, and designing levers of change accordingly
modes.definition_zh: 边沁的制裁理论是行为科学的早期完整模型：人之所以不做某事，是因为预期某种痛苦，而痛苦只有四个来源——物理制裁（自然后果：酗酒的头痛）、政治制裁（法律后果：罚款与监禁）、道德制裁（社会后果：名声与排斥，来自 community 的自发评价）、宗教制裁（超自然预期：此世或来世的报应）。同一行为可同时受四源约束，强度各异。诊断方法有三步：其一，归因——对要分析的行为（或要改变的失范）列出四源各自的现实威慑强度，常见错误是把道德直觉归功于法律、或把法律效力误认为道德共识；其二，找杠杆——判断哪个制裁源在此情境成本最低且响应最快：政治制裁可由立法立即改变但依赖执行，道德制裁传播快但难设计，物理制裁最稳定但不可编程；其三，冗余设计——高价值规范不应依赖单一制裁源，边沁的立法设计总是问『法律改变后，道德与物理制裁能否接住』。这一方法的深意是：社会控制是可分解、可组合的工程参数，不是不可分析的风俗混沌；政策失败常因用错了制裁源——用法律去执行只有道德能执行的规范（如礼仪），或期望道德去承担只有法律能承担的重负（如反垄断）。
modes.definition_en: Bentham's sanction theory is an early complete model of behavioral science: people refrain from an act because they expect pain, and pain has only four sources—the physical sanction (natural consequences: the drunkard's headache), the political sanction (legal consequences: fines and imprisonment), the moral or popular sanction (social consequences: reputation and ostracism, from the community's spontaneous verdict), and the religious sanction (supernatural expectation: requital here or hereafter). One act may be bound by all four sources with different strengths. The diagnostic has three steps. First, attribution: for the act to be analyzed (or the deviance to be changed), list each source's actual deterrent strength—the common errors are crediting law with what moral intuition supplies, or mistaking legal force for moral consensus. Second, locate the lever: judge which sanction source is cheapest and fastest-responding in this context—political sanction can change instantly by legislation but depends on enforcement, moral sanction spreads fast but resists design, physical sanction is most stable but not programmable. Third, redundancy design: high-value norms should not rest on a single source—Bentham's legislative designs always ask 'after the law changes, can the moral and physical sanctions catch it?' The deeper point: social control is a decomposable, combinable set of engineering parameters, not an unanalyzable miasma of custom; policy fails by using the wrong source—law enforcing what only morality can enforce (etiquette), or morality bearing what only law can bear (antitrust).
modes.source_chapter: 《道德与立法原理导论》第三、十章 (1789)；《宪法典》关于制度制裁的设计章节
modes.key_quote_zh: 快乐与痛苦有四个来源，故制裁有四类：自然的、政治的、道德的、宗教的——分不清来源的立法者，是在向空气挥鞭。
modes.key_quote_en: Pleasure and pain have four sources, and hence four sanctions—the physical, the political, the moral, and the religious: the legislator who cannot tell them apart is wielding a whip at the air.
process_zh: 四源归因：对目标行为逐源评估现实约束强度（自然后果/法律后果/声誉后果/信仰后果），标出失效源
选杠杆源：按『成本最低、响应最快、可执行性最高』排序，确定本次改变应主要动用哪个制裁源
设计制裁包：把改变拆配为多源组合——法律给底线、声誉给日常、环境设计给物理约束，避免单源过载
冗余与接应检验：模拟主要制裁源失效的情形，确认其余源能否维持规范，不能者补充设计
process_en: Attribute across four sources: assess each source's actual binding strength on the target act (natural, legal, reputational, faith-based consequences), marking failed sources
Choose the lever source: rank by lowest cost, fastest response, highest enforceability, deciding which sanction this change should chiefly deploy
Design the sanction package: apportion the change across sources—law sets the floor, reputation the daily discipline, environmental design the physical constraint—avoiding single-source overload
Test redundancy and handoff: simulate failure of the primary source and confirm the others can hold the norm; where they cannot, supplement the design
representative_cases_zh: 1789 年的原始分析：边沁解释为何禁止决斗的法令无效——政治制裁被道德制裁反向抵消（拒绝决斗者遭名誉放逐），改革必须先改道德源而非加重刑罚
禁酒令的制裁源错配：美国 1920 年代用政治制裁强推道德与物理制裁都不支持的规范——四源诊断的经典失败样本
边沁的监狱设计：把物理制裁（空间约束）与政治制裁（刑期）与『可预期性』（确定性威慑）组合，替代死刑与肉刑——多源组合的正面设计
反例警示：四源不是四分法游戏——宗教制裁在世俗化社会衰减后，其原本承担的规范必须有意识地重新配置（移入法律或道德），否则出现『制裁真空』；诊断者还须警惕把道德制裁误读为普遍共识，它常只是有话语权阶层的偏好
representative_cases_en: The original 1789 analysis: Bentham explained why statutes against dueling failed—the political sanction was countervailed by the moral one (the refuser suffered reputational exile), so reform had to move the moral source first rather than pile on penalties
Prohibition as source mismatch: 1920s America used political sanction to enforce a norm supported by neither moral nor physical sanction—the classic four-source failure case

Bentham's prison design: combining physical sanction (spatial constraint), political sanction (sentence length), and certainty of expectation (sure deterrence) to replace hanging and flogging—a positive multi-source design

Cautionary case: four sources are not a parlor taxonomy—when religious sanction decays in a secularizing society, the norms it carried must be deliberately reconfigured (into law or morality), or a 'sanction vacuum' opens; diagnosticians must also beware reading moral sanction as universal consensus when it is often only the preference of the stratum holding discourse
modern_applications_zh: 政策工具选择：反酒驾、反腐败等政策先做四源归因，判断单靠刑罚够不够、声誉机制如何配套
社区与平台治理：把违规行为按制裁源分解设计——技术约束（物理）、积分与曝光（道德）、封禁（政治）分层响应
企业文化变革：诊断某失范行为实际受哪源保护（KPI 政治制裁？同侪道德制裁？），从失效源下手而非加口号
个人习惯改造：把行为按自然后果、社交后果、规则后果重新安排环境，让物理制裁承担主要约束
modern_applications_en: Policy instrument choice: for drunk-driving or anticorruption policy, attribute across four sources first—whether penalties alone suffice, and how reputation mechanisms pair with them
Community and platform governance: decompose violations by sanction source—technical constraints (physical), points and exposure (moral), bans (political)—in tiered response
Corporate culture change: diagnose which source actually shields a misbehavior (KPI political sanction? peer moral sanction?) and start from the failed source, not slogans
Personal habit change: rearrange environments by natural, social, and rule-based consequences, letting physical sanction carry the main constraint

modes.domain_zh: 通过使被监督者永久可见、而监督是否在场不可验证的信息结构，以最小监督成本获得持久的行为矫正
modes.domain_en: Obtaining durable behavioral correction at minimal supervisory cost through an information structure in which the inspected is permanently visible while the presence of the inspector is unverifiable
modes.definition_zh: 全景敞视（Panopticon）是边沁 1787 年提出的制度设计：环形建筑中每个囚室对着中央瞭望塔，囚徒可见塔存在却无法知道塔内是否有人——被看者永久可见，看者不可验证。其设计原理超越了监狱：不确定性下的监督能让被监督者把『可能被看』内化为『一直在被看』，从而用最少的实际监督投入产生最大的持续约束。作为通用设计方法有三步：其一，构造不对称可见性——让被监督者的行为信息流向监督点，同时遮蔽监督者的在场状态（这是全部机制的枢纽：确定性监督成本高昂，不确定性监督把成本转嫁给被监督者的想象）；其二，把可见性转化为自动后果——违规在被观察到的时刻直接触发记录与后果，无需人工巡查，让『被看见』本身成为制裁源（道德制裁的自动化）；其三，审计监督者自身——边沁特别要求装置对公众开放，监督者同样可被外部看见，防止不对称可见性单向集中成暴政。这一方法的深意与它的恶名并存：它揭示了监督成本与行为规范之间的可设计关系（现代审计、随机的税务稽查、摄像头、平台内容审核都是其变体），而福柯对它的批判同样源于边沁自己写明的原理——权力若要节约，其最经济的形态就是让被统治者自我监视。设计者必须回答福柯式问题：这个装置对谁敞视？监督者的可见性条款是否真实可执行？
modes.definition_en: The Panopticon, proposed by Bentham in 1787, is an institutional design: a circular building with each cell facing a central inspection lodge—the inmate can see the lodge exists but cannot know whether anyone is in it—the inspected permanently visible, the inspector unverifiable. Its principle transcends the prison: supervision under uncertainty leads the supervised to internalize 'possibly watched' as 'always watched,' so minimal actual inspection yields maximal sustained constraint. As a general design method there are three steps. First, construct asymmetric visibility—let behavior information flow from the supervised to the inspection point while screening the inspector's presence (the pivot of the whole mechanism: certain supervision is costly; uncertain supervision transfers cost to the imagination of the supervised). Second, convert visibility into automatic consequences—violations trigger recording and consequence the moment they are observed, without human patrol, making 'being seen' itself a sanction (the automation of the moral sanction). Third, audit the inspector: Bentham specially required the establishment be open to the public, the supervisor likewise visible to outside eyes, preventing asymmetric visibility from one-directionally concentrating into tyranny. The deeper point coexists with its notoriety: it reveals a designable relation between the cost of supervision and the normalization of conduct (modern audits, randomized tax inspection, cameras, platform content moderation are all variants), and Foucault's critique springs from the very principle Bentham wrote down—if power must economize, its most economical form is the self-surveillance of the governed. The designer must answer the Foucauldian questions: to whom does this apparatus panoptically open, and are the inspector's visibility clauses truly enforceable?
modes.source_chapter: 《全景敞视监狱》(Panopticon; or, The Inspection-House, 1787/1791)；《宪法典》公开性与责任制章节 (Constitutional Code, 1830)
modes.key_quote_zh: 让被监督者永远不知道自己是否被看着，监督就从一个职位变成一种空气。
modes.key_quote_en: Let the inspected never know whether they are being watched, and supervision turns from an office into an atmosphere.
process_zh: 构造可见性不对称：设计信息流向使被监督者的行为对监督点可见，同时使监督是否在场不可验证
自动化后果触发：让观察到的违规直接接入记录与后果系统，剥离对人工巡查的依赖
设定监督者可见条款：规定监督行为本身对第三方（公众/审计者/被监督者代表）开放的机制
评估矫正与扭曲：追踪该装置对目标行为的矫正效果与对未被瞄准行为（创造性、信任、隐私）的抑制成本
process_en: Build the visibility asymmetry: design information flows so the supervised are visible to the inspection point while the inspector's presence stays unverifiable
Automate consequence triggering: wire observed violations directly into recording and consequence systems, removing dependence on human patrol
Set the inspector-visibility clause: stipulate mechanisms opening the supervision itself to third parties (public, auditors, representatives of the supervised)
Evaluate correction and distortion: track the apparatus's corrective effect on the targeted behavior and its suppression cost on behaviors not aimed at (creativity, trust, privacy)
representative_cases_zh: 1787 年的原始设计：边沁为伦敦 Millbank 提出的圆形监狱——建筑本身是论证，『监视的节省』被写为经济与道德的双重收益
随机税务稽查：现代税务机关以低概率高确定后果的抽查维持全量申报合规——不确定性威慑的大规模应用
开放式厨房与 HITRUST 审计：把操作过程暴露给不可验证的观察者以替代持续监督——原理在非惩罚场景的正向使用
反例警示：福柯 1975 年的批判正当——不对称可见性一旦只对上不对下，就生产顺从而非生产善；边沁自己预设的『装置对公众开放』条款在现实中常被省略，而这恰是设计从矫正工具滑向支配工具的分界线
representative_cases_en: The original 1787 design: the circular prison Bentham proposed for London's Millbank—the building itself is the argument, 'the economy of inspection' written as a double yield, economic and moral
Randomized tax audits: modern revenue authorities maintain full-population compliance with low-probability, high-consequence sampling—uncertain deterrence applied at scale
The open kitchen and third-party audits: exposing operations to unverifiable observers as a substitute for continuous supervision—the principle's positive use in non-punitive settings

Cautionary case: Foucault's 1975 critique is fair—where asymmetric visibility runs upward only, it produces obedience rather than goodness; Bentham's own 'open to the public' clause is routinely omitted in practice, and that omission is precisely the line where the apparatus slides from instrument of correction to instrument of domination
modern_applications_zh: 组织监督设计：远程办公中的可见性工具引入时同步立法『管理者可见性条款』——日志可被员工代表审计
平台算法治理：要求推荐系统的评分逻辑对独立审计者敞视，算法自身进入被监督位置
公共空间摄像头：以『监督者可见』原则设计——探头位置公示、调阅留痕、独立申诉通道
自我管理工具：个人把目标公开（不可验证的潜在观众）以低成本获得约束，替代昂贵的意志力
modern_applications_en: Organizational supervision: introduce visibility tooling in remote work together with an 'inspector visibility clause'—logs auditable by employee representatives
Platform algorithm governance: require recommendation systems to open their scoring logic to independent auditors, putting the algorithm itself under inspection
Public-space cameras: designed on the 'inspector visible' principle—published camera locations, logged retrievals, independent appeal channels
Self-management tools: individuals make goals public (an unverifiable potential audience) to obtain constraint at low cost, replacing expensive willpower

modes.name_zh: 伪概念清算问题重述法
modes.domain_zh: 把含糊的规范性争论重述为可裁决的效用问题，清算自然权利、社会契约、自然法等不可操作概念并替换为可检验的表述
modes.domain_en: Restating vague normative disputes as decidable questions of utility, clearing away inoperable concepts such as natural rights, social contract, and natural law, and replacing them with testable formulations
modes.definition_zh: 边沁对概念的最锋利操作是『清算』：凡不能翻译为快乐痛苦增减的概念，都要被审问其功用——它让谁受益？它遮蔽了什么问题？1791 年他对法国《人权宣言》的批判是范本：『自然权利是根本不存在的权利；不可剥夺的自然权利是踩在高跷上的胡说』——这不是否定人应受保护，而是指出『权利』话语把可争论的政治安排伪装成不可争论的自然事实，其后果恰是暴政可借用绝对语言（他要补充：真的暴政才始于把愿望说成天赋）。重述方法有三步：其一，翻译检验——把争论中的每个规范概念翻译为『某人群在某安排下的幸福增减』，能翻译者为合法概念（如『产权』=一种提高预期安全从而提高生产积极性的安排）；其二，暴露伪概念——不能翻译者被追问其社会功能，常见答案是它为一方立场提供免检的修辞护甲（『天赋』『永恒』『不可剥夺』都是停止讨论的装置）；其三，重构问题——用被清算概念遮蔽的真问题替换之：不问『人有没有表达的自然权利』，而问『何种表达限制的痛苦成本与其防害收益相抵』。这一方法的深意是：概念的含糊不是小疵而是政治技术的核心——绝对化语言正是绝对权力的入口；每一个拒绝翻译的『神圣』词汇，都值得追问谁在用它、防着什么。
modes.definition_en: Bentham's sharpest operation on concepts was 'clearance': any concept untranslatable into increments of pleasure and pain is to be interrogated for its function—whom does it benefit, and what question does it obscure? His 1791 critique of the French Declaration of Rights is the model: 'natural rights is simple nonsense; natural and imprescriptible rights is nonsense upon stilts'—not denying that persons deserve protection, but showing how 'rights' talk disguises contestable political arrangements as uncontestable facts of nature, with the consequence that tyranny can borrow the absolute language (Bentham would add: real tyranny begins when wishes are proclaimed as endowments). The restatement method has three steps. First, the translation test: render every normative concept in the dispute as 'the happiness increment or decrement of some population under some arrangement'; what translates is legitimate (e.g., 'property' = an arrangement raising expected security and hence productive incentive). Second, expose the pseudo-concept: the untranslatable is asked for its social function—the usual answer is that it supplies one side免检 rhetorical armor ('endowed,' 'eternal,' 'imprescriptible' are devices for stopping discussion). Third, reconstruct the question: replace with the real question the cleared concept obscured—not 'do people have a natural right of expression,' but 'which restrictions on expression have pain costs outweighed by their harm-prevention yield.' The deeper point: conceptual vagueness is not a small blemish but the core of political technology—absolutist language is the entrance of absolute power; every 'sacred' word refusing translation deserves the question of who wields it and against what.
modes.source_chapter: 《无政府主义的谬误》(Anarchical Fallacies, 约1791)；《道德与立法原理导论》第二章 (1789)
modes.key_quote_zh: 自然权利是根本不存在的权利；不可剥夺的自然权利，是踩在高跷上的胡说。
modes.key_quote_en: Natural rights is simple nonsense; natural and imprescriptible rights is nonsense upon stilts.
process_zh: 清单化争议概念：列出争论中的全部规范术语（权利/自然/契约/尊严/传统），逐个登记其使用位置
翻译检验：把每个术语改写为『某人群在某安排下的幸福增减』——通过者保留为缩写，不通过者进入清算
追问社会功能：对被清算概念问三问——谁在用？停止了什么讨论？谁因此免检？
重构真问题：用可裁决的效用问题替换被遮蔽的原问题，并重开被修辞中止的讨论
process_en: Inventory the disputed concepts: list all normative terms in the dispute (rights, nature, contract, dignity, tradition), logging where each is deployed
Apply the translation test: rewrite each term as 'the happiness increment or decrement of some population under some arrangement'—those passing are kept as shorthand; failures go to clearance
Interrogate the social function: for each cleared concept ask three questions—who wields it, what discussion does it stop, who thereby escapes scrutiny?
Reconstruct the real question: replace the obscured original question with a decidable utility question and reopen the discussion the rhetoric had suspended
representative_cases_zh: 1791 年批判法国《人权宣言》：逐条清算『人权』的不可操作表述，并论证绝对化权利语言反而为恐怖统治提供了语法——概念清算改变政治批判方式的实例
对布莱克斯通的清算：《政府片论》拆解『宪制的智慧来自历史沉淀』的修辞，把问题重写为『现行安排的幸福净额是否可被替代安排超越』
对『自然法』的功能追问：边沁指出『符合自然』在实践中意味着『符合论者自己的偏好被投射到宇宙』——伪概念的社会功能分析
反例警示：清算易滑向犬儒——边沁清算『权利』却并不否认保护的需求（他起草的宪法典中有大量权利性条款）；正确用法是清算概念的不透明性而非否定其指向的价值，否则清算沦为单方面的修辞武器
representative_cases_en: The 1791 critique of the French Declaration: clause-by-clause clearance of the inoperable formulations of 'rights,' arguing that absolutist rights language supplied the grammar of the Terror—an instance of conceptual clearance changing the mode of political critique

Clearing Blackstone: A Fragment on Government dismantled the rhetoric of 'the wisdom of the constitution as historical sediment,' rewriting the question as 'whether the present arrangement's net happiness can be surpassed by alternatives'

The functional interrogation of 'natural law': Bentham noted that 'according to nature' in practice means 'the disputant's own preferences projected onto the universe'—social-function analysis of a pseudo-concept

Cautionary case: clearance slides easily into cynicism—Bentham cleared 'rights' without denying the need for protection (his Constitutional Code contains many rights-type provisions); the correct use clears the concept's opacity, not the value it points to, or clearance degenerates into one-sided rhetoric
modern_applications_zh: 政策辩论审计：对『国家安全』『公共利益』『历史必然』等词执行翻译检验，拒绝翻译者承担论证负担
合同与条款审查：把『公平』『合理』『国际惯例』等含糊词改写为可裁决的义务条款，清除免责修辞
组织话语治理：会议纪要禁用不可操作的定性词（『不成熟』『没感觉』），要求改写为可检验的判断
AI 对齐文档：把『有益无害』改写为可度量的幸福与痛苦代理指标，暴露『价值』一词下的权重选择
modern_applications_en: Audit of policy debate: run the translation test on 'national security,' 'public interest,' 'historical necessity'; those refusing translation bear the burden of argument
Contract and clause review: rewrite vague words—'fair,' 'reasonable,' 'industry custom'—into decidable obligations, sweeping out disclaimer rhetoric
Organizational discourse governance: ban non-operable verdicts in minutes ('immature,' 'doesn't feel right'), requiring rewrite into testable judgments
AI alignment documentation: recast 'beneficial and harmless' into measurable proxies of happiness and pain, exposing the weight choices hidden in the word 'values'

modes.domain_zh: 给流行的论证谬误逐个命名并编目，通过暴露其运作机制使修辞论证在公共讨论中失去隐身能力
modes.domain_en: Naming and cataloguing popular argumentative fallacies one by one, and by exposing their mechanisms stripping rhetorical arguments of their capacity to hide in public discussion
modes.definition_zh: 《谬误集》（1824）展示了一种独特的批判工艺：谬误的力量来自不被命名——一旦一个混淆模式有了名字与案例目录，它在下一次出现时就会被在场者认出并拒付。边沁把谬误按功能分类（而非按逻辑形式）：如『权威转移』（诉诸人物或古制替代论证）、『问题偷换』（question-begging appellatives：用『无政府主义者』『颠覆者』命名对手从而预设其错）、『复杂问题』（把争议塞进不可拒绝的措辞）、『模糊人民』（引用『人民』『国家』说话而该主体无法到庭作证）。方法有三步：其一，命名——为反复出现的混淆模式起一个可引用的名字，名字是疫苗；其二，编目——每个谬误配以真实例句与拆解，展示其如何利用听者的心理捷径（敬畏、恐惧、从众）而非逻辑；其三，反制预案——对每种谬误给出标准回应句式，使在场者无须重新推理即可拒付。这一方法的深意是：公共论证的质量取决于谬误的可见性，而非论证者的德性——把谬误从隐形武器变成显形道具，是成本最低的辩论基础设施。现代事实核查、逻辑谬误清单、辩论规范都继承了这一工艺。
modes.definition_en: The Book of Fallacies (1824) exhibits a distinctive craft of critique: the power of a fallacy lies in its being unnamed—once a confusion pattern has a name and a catalogue of cases, its next appearance will be recognized and refused by those present. Bentham classified fallacies by function, not logical form: 'authority-baiting' (substituting person or antiquity for argument), 'question-begging appellatives' (naming opponents 'anarchists' or 'subversives' so as to presuppose their error), the 'complex question' (smuggling controversy into unrejectable phrasing), and 'vagueness of the people' (citing 'the people' or 'the nation' as witness though the entity cannot appear in court). The method has three steps. First, naming: give each recurring confusion a citable name—the name is the vaccine. Second, cataloguing: furnish each fallacy with real sentences and a dissection showing how it exploits the hearer's psychological shortcuts (awe, fear, conformity) rather than logic. Third, countermove presets: for each fallacy provide a standard response formula, so those present can refuse it without re-deriving the reasoning. The deeper point: the quality of public argument depends on the visibility of fallacies, not the virtue of arguers—turning fallacies from invisible weapons into visible props is the cheapest infrastructure of debate. Modern fact-checking, lists of logical fallacies, and debate norms all inherit this craft.
modes.source_chapter: 《谬误集》(The Book of Fallacies, 1824)；《手ンズマン手册》(The Handbook of Political Fallacies)
modes.key_quote_zh: 谬误最怕的不是反驳，而是被点名——一个有了名字的谬误，从此只能在羞耻中工作。
modes.key_quote_en: What a fallacy fears is not refutation but being named—a named fallacy can thenceforth work only in shame.
process_zh: 捕获与命名：在真实讨论中捕获反复出现的混淆模式，为其起一个可引用、可传播的名字
编目拆解：为每个谬误建立案例库，逐例标注它利用了哪种心理捷径、遮蔽了哪个真实问题
编制反制句式：为每种谬误写标准回应（『你说的『人民』是谁？可否具体到某个群体的何种损失？』）
公开化：把目录发布到目标共同体的讨论规范中，使拒付谬误成为在场者的低成本默认动作
process_en: Capture and name: harvest recurring confusion patterns from real discussion and give each a citable, spreadable name
Catalogue and dissect: build a case library per fallacy, marking for each which psychological shortcut it exploits and which real question it obscures
Draft countermove formulas: write standard responses per fallacy ('Who exactly is this 'people' you cite? Can it be specified as a loss to which group?')
Publish: install the catalogue in the target community's discussion norms, making refusal of fallacies the low-cost default move for those present
representative_cases_zh: 1824 年《谬误集》的原初战役：逐一命名议会辩论中的护旧谬误（『我们的祖先如此』『这条路走的人多』），为改革派提供现成的拆解武器
『问题偷换称谓』的当代显影：给政策批评者贴『否定发展』『唱衰』标签从而免于回应论证——边沁命名过的机制原样运行
事实核查行业的谱系：从命名（『cherry-picking』『whataboutism』）到编目到标准反制句式——谬误工艺的现代制度化
反例警示：命名工具同样可被武器化——『你这是诉诸权威』本身可成为拒斥一切专业意见的谬误；使用目录须区分『谬误模式』与『实质异议』，并接受自己的论证同样被目录检验的对称性
representative_cases_en: The original 1824 campaign of The Book of Fallacies: naming one by one the antiquity-pleasing fallacies of parliamentary debate ('our ancestors did so,' 'this path is well trodden'), furnishing reformers with ready-made dissecting weapons
Question-begging appellatives visible today: tagging policy critics 'anti-development' or 'doom-sayers' to escape answering arguments—Bentham's named mechanism running as ever
The genealogy of fact-checking: from naming ('cherry-picking,' 'whataboutism') to cataloguing to standard countermove formulas—the modern institutionalization of the fallacy craft

Cautionary case: the naming tool can be weaponized too—'that's an appeal to authority' can itself become a fallacy rejecting all expert opinion; users of the catalogue must distinguish 'fallacy patterns' from 'substantive dissent,' and accept the symmetry that their own arguments face the same catalogue
modern_applications_zh: 团队辩论规范：维护内部谬误目录（含案例与反制句式），会议中允许『点名』式打断以节约讨论时间
内容平台审核：把操纵性修辞模式编目（虚假两难、偷换主体），用于标注而非删除，训练用户识别力
公共写作：反驳文章采用『命名-案例-反制』三段式，使批判可复用而非一次性
媒体素养课程：以边沁式功能分类（而非学院逻辑分类）教授谬误识别，贴近真实说服场景
modern_applications_en: Team debate norms: maintain an internal fallacy catalogue (with cases and countermove formulas), allowing 'name-and-hold' interruptions in meetings to save discussion time
Content-platform moderation: catalogue manipulative rhetorical patterns (false dilemma, subject substitution) for labeling rather than deletion, training user recognition
Public writing: structure rebuttals as 'name—case—countermove,' making critique reusable rather than one-off
Media-literacy curricula: teach fallacy recognition with Bentham-style functional classification rather than scholastic logic taxonomy, closer to real persuasion scenes

modes.name_zh: 痛苦最小化刑罚设计法
modes.domain_zh: 以『惩罚本身是恶，仅在排除更大之恶时正当』为公理，按四目标与比例规则设计总痛苦最小的刑罚体系
modes.domain_en: Taking as axiom that 'punishment is itself evil, justified only insofar as it excludes some greater evil,' designing the penal system of minimum total pain along four aims and rules of proportion
modes.definition_zh: 《道德与立法原理导论》第十三至十六章给出了刑罚设计的完整工程学。公理：一切惩罚本身是恶——它对受罚者施加痛苦，若不产生更大的排除之恶，就应废除。由此推出不应惩罚的四种情形：无据（行为无危害）、无效（惩罚不能防止）、无益（恶超过防止之恶）、不必要（更小代价可达同样目的）。设计方法有四步：其一，量化危害——对每种罪行估算其行为危害（第一级）与二次危害（恐慌、仿效）账目；其二，按四目标配置刑罚——威慑（让潜在者算出不划算）、剥夺能力（关押期间无法再犯）、矫正（改变行为倾向）、赔偿（补偿受害人）——每种目标对应不同的刑罚形态与期限；其三，执行比例规则——刑罚强度略超罪行收益即可（超过的部分是纯浪费的痛苦），确定性比严厉性更有效（轻而必罚优于重而偶罚），且惩罚须能被罪行本身的描述传达（让人们从法条就能算出后果）；其四，设置下行约束——任何新刑罚须先证明现有措施不够。这一方法直接终结了死刑与肉刑的默认地位：在边沁的账簿上，死刑无法矫正、剥夺能力可用终身监禁替代、威慑不确定——净效用低于监禁，故应废除（他是历史上第一位系统性论证废除死刑的司法理论家）。深意在于：刑罚不是正义的戏剧而是防害的工程，判断问题永远是『这套痛苦开支买到了多少安全』。
modes.definition_en: Chapters thirteen to sixteen of An Introduction to the Principles of Morals and Legislation supply a complete engineering of penal design. Axiom: all punishment is itself evil—it inflicts pain on the punished; where it excludes no greater evil, it should be abolished. Hence four cases where punishment ought not to apply: groundless (the act does no harm), inefficacious (punishment cannot prevent), unprofitable (its evil exceeds the evil prevented), needless (the same end reachable at less cost). The design has four steps. First, quantify harm: for each offense draw the account of primary harm and secondary harm (alarm, imitation). Second, allocate punishment across four aims—deterrence (making potential offenders compute the act as a bad buy), incapacitation (no reoffending while confined), reformation (changing disposition), compensation (making the victim whole)—each aim matched to different forms and terms. Third, enforce the rules of proportion: punishment need exceed only the profit of the offense (the excess is pure wasted pain); certainty beats severity (light and certain outweighs heavy and occasional); and the punishment must be communicable from the description of the offense itself (people should be able to compute consequences from the statute). Fourth, set the downward constraint: any new punishment must first prove existing measures insufficient. The method directly ended the default status of hanging and flogging: on Bentham's ledger, capital punishment cannot reform, incapacitation is replaceable by life imprisonment, and its deterrence is uncertain—net utility below confinement, hence to be abolished (he was the first jurist systematically to argue for abolition). The deeper point: punishment is not a drama of justice but an engineering of harm prevention; the standing question is 'how much safety did this expenditure of pain buy?'
modes.source_chapter: 《道德与立法原理导论》第十三至十六章 (1789)
modes.key_quote_zh: 一切惩罚都是恶：按功利原理，无谓的惩罚本身就是暴政。
modes.key_quote_en: All punishment is mischief: all punishment in itself is evil—upon the principle of utility, if it ought at all to be admitted, it ought only to be admitted in as far as it promises to exclude some greater evil.
process_zh: 结算危害账目：对每种目标行为估算第一级危害与二级危害（恐慌/仿效/安全感侵蚀），确认危害存在且可归因
按四目标配置：威慑/剥夺能力/矫正/赔偿分别需要何种刑罚形态与期限，避免单一刑罚（如死刑）承担全部目标
执行比例与确定性规则：强度略超罪行收益即止；轻而必罚优先于重而偶罚；后果须从法条可算出
设置下行约束与复审：新刑罚须先证伪现有措施；定期用实际再犯与威慑数据重算刑罚账目
process_en: Settle the harm account: for each target act estimate primary and secondary harm (alarm, imitation, erosion of felt security), confirming harm exists and is attributable
Allocate by four aims: what forms and terms of punishment deterrence, incapacitation, reformation, and compensation each require, avoiding a single punishment (e.g., death) bearing all aims
Enforce proportion and certainty: cap intensity just above the offense's profit; prefer light-and-certain to heavy-and-occasional; make consequences computable from the statute
Set the downward constraint and review: any new punishment must first falsify existing measures; periodically recompute the penal account with actual recidivism and deterrence data
representative_cases_zh: 1789 年的原始论证：对死刑的系统清算——无法矫正、剥夺能力可用监禁替代、对暴力罪的威慑不确定而成本却最高，应予废除；边沁 1830 年代致各国立法者的废死呼吁是方法论的制度化输出
贝卡里亚-边沁谱系：从贝卡里亚《论犯罪与惩罚》(1764) 到边沁的工程化，刑罚改革从格言变为可逐罪计算的设计学
监狱运动的影响：边沁的方案虽未被全盘采纳，其『以监禁替代肉刑+按危险度分级』的框架进入 19 世纪监狱改革主流
反例警示：痛苦最小化不等于无所痛苦——边沁的账簿未充分计入监禁自身的心理与家庭外溢痛苦（现代研究证明其远超 18 世纪估计），且『矫正』目标曾被滥用为无限期治疗；当代使用者须把监禁成本全项入账并设矫正措施的司法审查
representative_cases_en: The original 1789 argument: the systematic clearance of capital punishment—unable to reform, replaceable by imprisonment for incapacitation, uncertain against violent crime yet costliest—hence to be abolished; Bentham's 1830s appeal to legislators everywhere institutionalized the method
The Beccaria-Bentham lineage: from Beccaria's On Crimes and Punishments (1764) to Bentham's engineering, penal reform turned from aphorism into a design science computable offense by offense

Influence on the prison movement: though never adopted wholesale, Bentham's frame—confinement over corporal punishment, graded by dangerousness—entered the mainstream of nineteenth-century prison reform

Cautionary case: pain-minimization is not pain-freeness—Bentham's ledger under-counted imprisonment's own psychological and family-spillover pain (modern research far exceeds eighteenth-century estimates), and the 'reformation' aim was abused into indefinite treatment; contemporary users must book confinement costs in full and subject correctional measures to judicial review
modern_applications_zh: 量刑指南设计：按危害结算+四目标配置+比例规则的完整流程重算量刑区间，公开各档的威慑证据
企业内惩戒制度：把解雇/降级/警告按四目标配置（威慑/隔离/矫正/补偿），废除无功能的形式惩罚
平台封禁分级：违规按危害分级对应功能限制而非一刀切封号，补偿受害者（删除/赔偿）单列
刑事政策辩论：以『痛苦开支购买的安全』重述死刑与长刑期辩论，要求正反双方提交威慑与再犯数据
modern_applications_en: Sentencing-guideline design: recompute sentencing bands by the full sequence—harm settlement, four-aim allocation, proportion rules—with deterrence evidence published per band
Corporate discipline systems: allocate dismissal, demotion, and warning across the four aims (deterrence, incapacitation, reformation, compensation), abolishing purely ceremonial punishment
Tiered platform bans: grade violations by harm to graded functional limits rather than blanket bans; victim compensation (removal, restitution) kept as a separate track
Criminal-policy debate: restate the death-penalty and long-sentence debates as 'safety bought per unit of pain,' requiring both sides to submit deterrence and recidivism data

modes.domain_zh: 对改革对象编制穷举式全要素清册，逐项标注效用判据与改革杠杆，交付一张可执行、可分工、可追踪的改进地图
modes.domain_en: Compiling an exhaustive all-element inventory of the object of reform, annotating each item with its utility criterion and lever of change, and delivering an executable, divisible, trackable map of improvement
modes.definition_zh: 边沁的改革实践有一个统一形状：不做零散批判，而做穷举清册。他的《宪法典》为每个国家机器职位逐项编写职责、问责与考核条款；他的司法证据改革从全部证据类型编起；他的废除清单把英国法中所有『无效用法律』逐条列出——『Panopticon』一词的词源『全视』既是监狱设计也是他的方法自白：看见全部，才能改革全部。方法有四步：其一，定界清册——把对象（一个法律体系/一个组织/一个流程）分解为穷举的要素清单，宁滥勿缺，遗漏项比冗余项代价更高（遗漏的要素会以『例外』形式回来腐蚀规则）；其二，逐项标注——每个要素登记三个字段：效用判据（它为何存在、服务谁的幸福）、当前状态（符合/偏离/无法验证）、改革杠杆（修/废/换/外包给其他制裁源）；其三，分工交付——清册按要素切块分给不同的执行者，边沁式改革是可并行的工程而非一个天才的单线程写作；其四，追踪更新——清册是活文档，要素状态随实施反馈更新，改革地图成为持续的审计工具。这一方法的深意是：改革失败常因地图不全——只改革被抱怨的部分，而未列入清册的既得利益结构原样存活；穷举清册把『改革』从修辞变成排期表。
modes.definition_en: Bentham's reform practice has one uniform shape: not scattered criticism but exhaustive inventory. His Constitutional Code drafts, post by post, the duties, accountability, and appraisal clauses of every organ of state; his evidence reform begins from a catalogue of all types of evidence; his repeal inventory lists England's 'ineffectual laws' item by item—the etymology of 'Panopticon,' 'all-seeing,' is both a prison design and a self-confession of method: see everything, to reform everything. The method has four steps. First, delimit the inventory: decompose the object (a legal system, an organization, a process) into an exhaustive list of elements—err on surplus; an omitted element returns as 'exception' to corrode the rules, at higher cost than redundancy. Second, annotate item by item: register three fields per element—utility criterion (why it exists, whose happiness it serves), current state (compliant / deviant / unverifiable), and lever of change (amend, repeal, replace, outsource to another sanction source). Third, divide and deliver: split the inventory among executors by element—Benthamite reform is parallelizable engineering, not one genius's single-threaded writing. Fourth, track and update: the inventory is a living document; element states update with implementation feedback, the reform map becoming a standing audit instrument. The deeper point: reform fails above all because the map is incomplete—only the complained-of parts are reformed while unlisted interest structures survive intact; the exhaustive inventory turns 'reform' from rhetoric into a schedule.
modes.source_chapter: 《宪法典》(Constitutional Code, 1830)；《司法证据原理》(Rationale of Judicial Evidence, 1827)；废除清单通信集
modes.key_quote_zh: 看见全部，是改革全部的前提——没有穷举的清册，就没有诚实的改革。
modes.key_quote_en: Seeing everything is the precondition of reforming everything—without an exhaustive inventory there is no honest reform.
process_zh: 定界与穷举：把对象分解为全要素清单，显式登记遗漏风险（哪些类型的要素最常被漏掉：例外条款、隐性补贴、非正式惯例）
逐项三字段标注：效用判据/当前状态/改革杠杆，无法陈述效用判据的要素直接进入废除候选
切块分工：按要素把清单分配给并行执行者，统一字段格式与验收标准，汇成一张总地图
追踪更新：建立要素状态变更日志，定期重审判据——清册从改革方案演化为常态审计工具
process_en: Delimit and enumerate: decompose the object into an all-element list, logging omission risk explicitly (which element types get missed most: exception clauses, hidden subsidies, informal conventions)
Annotate with three fields per item: utility criterion / current state / lever of change; elements with no statable criterion go straight onto the repeal shortlist
Divide and parallelize: allocate the list to concurrent executors by element, with uniform field formats and acceptance criteria, converging on one master map
Track and update: keep an element-state change log and re-audit criteria periodically—the inventory evolving from reform plan into standing audit tool
representative_cases_zh: 《宪法典》的职位清册：从最高权力到基层书记逐职位编写职责与问责——穷举式制度设计的极限样本
废除清单的实践：数百条『无效法律』逐条列出并附废除理由，成为 19 世纪英国法律改革的实际弹药库
证据类型的全编目：《司法证据原理》穷举全部证据形态并逐类审计其可靠性成本——从分类学到改革方案的示范
反例警示：穷举有真实的成本曲线——边沁的宪法典因过度完备（每个细节预设到身后）而被批评为不可用的机器；清册须分层（主干穷举、细节抽样深审），并接受『地图不等于领土』：清册更新的速度必须跟上对象变化的速度
representative_cases_en: The office inventory of the Constitutional Code: duties and accountability drafted post by post from supreme power down to junior clerks—the limit case of exhaustive institutional design
The repeal list in practice: hundreds of 'ineffectual laws' itemized with reasons for repeal, becoming the actual ammunition of nineteenth-century English law reform
The full catalogue of evidence types: Rationale of Judicial Evidence enumerating all forms of evidence and auditing each for reliability cost—taxonomy turned directly into reform scheme

Cautionary case: exhaustion has a real cost curve—Bentham's Constitutional Code was faulted as an unusable machine for being complete past death (every detail pre-set); inventories must be layered (exhaustive trunk, sampled deep-audit for detail) and accept that the map is not the territory: the inventory's update speed must match the object's rate of change
modern_applications_zh: 组织变革项目：先编制全要素清册（制度/流程/人员/非正式惯例）再排改革计划，未入册的利益结构显式登记为风险
技术系统迁移：穷举现有系统全部功能与暗依赖后再设计新架构，防止『例外功能』在迁移后失控
政策落地清单：法规出台时附执行要素清册（谁执行/何判据/何杠杆/何时复审），把『纸面法』变成可追踪工程
个人改进系统：对自身时间/技能/承诺编制穷举清单，逐项标注效用与放弃/改进杠杆，替代零散的新年决心
modern_applications_en: Organizational transformation: compile the all-element inventory (rules, processes, people, informal conventions) before scheduling reform, registering unlisted interest structures as explicit risks
Technical system migration: enumerate every feature and hidden dependency of the legacy system before designing the new architecture, so 'exception features' do not run wild after migration
Policy implementation checklists: ship statutes with an execution-element inventory (who enforces, what criterion, what lever, when reviewed), turning paper law into trackable engineering
Personal improvement systems: build exhaustive inventories of one's time, skills, and commitments, annotating each with utility and abandon/amend levers, in place of scattered New Year resolutions

modes.domain_zh: 把毕生著作当作一项跨越自己寿命的系统工程来交付——用代理人、修订指示与活页体系使思想在身后继续接受检验与更新
modes.domain_en: Delivering a life's work as a system-engineering project outlasting its author—using agents, revision instructions, and loose-leaf structures so the thought keeps being tested and updated after death
modes.definition_zh: 边沁留下了约六万页未刊手稿，而这不是遗憾而是设计：他把著作当作一个不随作者死亡而冻结的系统。方法有四条：其一，模块化写作——手稿以可重排的片段（papyraceous fragments）构成，章节是活页而非装订的定本，任何片段都可被新证据替换而不牵动全局；其二，代理人网络——他组织了一个跨国抄写与翻译团队（包括年轻的密尔与鲍林），并给代理人明确的修订授权与进度追踪，让生产不依赖作者个人在场；其三，修订指示前置——对未完成部分留下明确的『此处应如何更新』的指示（如对法典各章的修订备忘），使后来者能按同一工程逻辑续建而非重新发明；其四，预期公开——他生前把大量未完成稿公开（如《宪法典》分卷即出即修订），宁可交付不完美的活系统也不扣压到『完成』。这一方法的深意是：知识的效用不取决于作者完成的那一天，而取决于它被使用与修正的每一天——把『著作』从艺术品改造成基础设施的人，才是真正打算让思想活得比自己久。现代开源项目的维护者制度、活文档与持续交付，都是这一方法的直系后裔。与之对照，深意亦是警示：边沁身后手稿整理拖延百年，多数至今未刊——活系统工程对组织延续性的依赖，比天才的孤本更苛刻。
modes.definition_en: Bentham left about sixty thousand pages of unpublished manuscripts—and this was design, not regret: he treated his works as a system not frozen by the author's death. The method has four parts. First, modular writing: manuscripts composed as re-arrangeable fragments ('papyraceous fragments'), chapters as loose leaves rather than bound finals, any fragment replaceable by new evidence without dragging the whole. Second, an agent network: he organized a transnational team of copyists and translators (including the young John Stuart Mill and John Bowring) with explicit revision mandates and progress tracking, so production did not depend on the author's personal presence. Third, revision instructions up front: for unfinished parts he left explicit directions on 'how this should be updated' (revision memoranda for the Code's chapters), letting successors continue under the same engineering logic rather than reinvent. Fourth, publish in expectation: he released much unfinished work during his life (the Constitutional Code appearing volume by volume, revised as it went), preferring to deliver an imperfect living system over withholding until 'completion.' The deeper point: the utility of knowledge depends not on the day its author finished but on every day it is used and revised; only one who rebuilds 'a work' from artwork into infrastructure truly intends the thought to outlive him. Maintainer institutions of modern open-source projects, living documents, and continuous delivery are all direct descendants. The contrast is also the warning: the posthumous editing dragged on for a century and much remains unprinted—a living system-engineering project demands even more of organizational continuity than the lonely masterpiece.
modes.source_chapter: 《宪法典》分卷出版序言 (1830)；边沁书信与《边沁手稿》档案 (Bentham MSS, University College London)
modes.key_quote_zh: 著作不该是一件完成的艺术品，而应是一座仍在施工的工程——只要效用还在增长，就不宣布竣工。
modes.key_quote_en: A work should be not a finished artwork but a project still under construction—so long as its utility grows, declare no completion.
process_zh: 模块化写作：把成果拆为可独立替换的单元（章节/模块/条款），单元间用显式接口（编号、引用、术语表）而非物理装订连接
建设代理人网络：为每个模块指定可授权的维护者与译者，写明修订授权范围与进度追踪方式
前置修订指示：对每个未完成模块留下『当前假设、待验证问题、更新触发条件』的交接备忘
预期公开与持续交付：按模块成熟度分批发布，不等待整体完成；发布物带版本号与已知缺陷清单
process_en: Write modularly: break the work into independently replaceable units (chapters, modules, clauses) connected by explicit interfaces (numbering, citation, glossary) rather than physical binding
Build the agent network: appoint authorizable maintainers and translators per module, stating revision mandates and progress-tracking methods
Leave revision instructions up front: for each unfinished module record a handover memo of current assumptions, open questions, and update triggers
Publish in expectation, deliver continuously: release by module maturity in batches, never waiting for the whole; ship with version numbers and known-defect lists
representative_cases_zh: 《宪法典》的边写边出：1830 年第一卷出版时第二卷仍在修订——预期公开的原始实践
代理人体系的运转：鲍林最终主编《边沁文集》(1838-1843) 十一卷，密尔早年为其做编辑——作者不在场时工程继续的证明
六万页手稿的当代整理：伦敦大学学院边沁项目至今仍在按其方法出版新卷——身后工程跨越近两百年仍在施工
反例警示：活系统依赖组织而组织会死——边沁未指定单一代码维护权，导致 19 世纪代理人之间互相竞争性修订、文本可靠性受损；续建工程必须在生前指定唯一权威版本源与争议仲裁规则，否则活页会变成活战场
representative_cases_en: The Constitutional Code published as written: volume one out in 1830 while volume two was still being revised—the original practice of publishing in expectation
The agent system at work: Bowring eventually edited the eleven-volume Works of Jeremy Bentham (1838-1843), the young Mill served as editor—proof the engineering continues in the author's absence

Sixty thousand pages under current collation: the Bentham Project at University College London still publishes new volumes on his method—an after-death project under construction for nearly two centuries

Cautionary case: a living system depends on organization, and organizations die—Bentham named no single custodial authority, so nineteenth-century agents produced competing revisions and textual reliability suffered; a continuation project must designate, while alive, the sole authoritative version source and arbitration rules, or the loose leaves become a living battlefield
modern_applications_zh: 开源与知识库维护：用模块化+维护者授权+交接备忘的完整流程运营长期项目，不押注单一维护者
个人知识系统：笔记按可替换单元组织并留『当前假设/待验证』字段，接受体系永远未完成
组织文档治理：关键制度文档设唯一权威版本源、修订授权与公开变更日志，禁止并行暗版本
学术交付策略：分卷即出即修订，用预印本与版本号取代『等写完』，让批评进入修订循环
modern_applications_en: Open-source and knowledge-base maintenance: run long-term projects with modular structure, maintainer mandates, and handover memos, never betting on a single maintainer
Personal knowledge systems: organize notes as replaceable units carrying 'current assumptions / open questions' fields, accepting that the system is never finished
Organizational document governance: a single authoritative version source, revision mandates, and public change logs for key institutional documents—no parallel shadow versions
Academic delivery strategy: publish volume by volume with preprints and versioning in place of 'wait until done,' letting criticism enter the revision loop
